Ben — thanks for the details and the CSV. Quick take below and attaching a preliminary quote (datadog_quote_v1.pdf).

Options we recommend:
1) Conservative: keep existing 90d hot retention for critical services, move non-critical service logs to 365d cold (savings ~22% on retention charges).
2) Aggressive: 30d hot for most telemetry + 365d cold for archived logs routed to our S3 cold tier (savings ~38% but increases retrieval latency).

We can offer a 10% one-time account credit if you commit to a 12-month prepaid retention commitment at the conservative tier. For the aggressive option, we can discuss a larger credit tied to a 24-month commit.

Notes/ask:
- We need a short MAP doc (one-page) listing migration milestones to approve the credit.
- For Grafana archival routing, we coordinate with Grafana Cloud but there are additional egress and integration considerations — cc'ing sales@grafana.com to loop them in.

Available times for a 30m call next Tue/Wed morning.

—Alex

Thanks for the ping. Quick procurement/legal read:

1) Credit ask: a one-time credit tied to migration costs is reasonable, but Procurement prefers a capped credit expressed as a dollar amount rather than a percent so we can reconcile against invoices. Suggest asking for a $35k–$50k migration credit for the first-year migration work.

2) Commit term: avoid locking 24-months for the aggressive option. We can accept 12 months for pricing guarantees with an option to renew the commit under renegotiated terms.

3) SLA/restore windows: redline to require documented cold retrieval RTO/RPO and a financial remedy if retrieval exceeds X hours for security incident investigations. I can draft a short redline (attaching redline_sla_datadog.docx) — procurement/legal will own this.

4) Compliance: For routing archives to Grafana Cloud, we need a written data flow diagram and confirmation of the GDPR data processing addendum if any EU data is included. For now mark as "possible" travel but exclude EU customer logs until we confirm.

Next steps I recommend:
- Ben to ask Alex for a MAP template we can sign.
- We send the redline to Alex and request a formal revised quote reflecting the migration credit and the 12-month prepay commit.

I'll attach the redline and a short checklist for SOC2 / compliance artifacts.

—Laura
